name: 2-cyanopyridine
description: 2-Cyanopyridine (CAS 100-70-9 ), also known as 2-CP, is a pyridine-based nitrile intermediate used across pharmaceutical synthesis, agrochemical manufacturing, and specialty chemical production. It serves primarily as a building block for constructing more complex heterocyclic structures and as a ligand precursor in catalytic systems. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is a key synthetic intermediate. This material is used for active ingredients including antifungals, antivirals, and kinase inhibitors, where the nitrile group undergoes controlled transformation into amidines, tetrazoles, or carboxylic acids. Agrochemical producers use it to synthesize pyridine-based fungicides and herbicides at commercial scale. In coordination chemistry, it functions as a bidentate ligand component for metal-complex catalysts. These catalysts are used in fine chemical and polymer processes. Flavor and fragrance formulators also reference it as picolinic acid nitrile in trace-level applications targeting specific aroma profiles. The product is supplied as a colorless to pale yellow liquid or low-melting solid, depending on purity and storage conditions. It is available in technical and high-purity grades for various uses. Pharmaceutical-grade material typically meets custom specification requirements for residual solvent and metal content.
